text:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v3.2.1 -> routing 5% eu-west (commit 9f8a3b6)
deploy-bot: changelog: minor kv-cache fix, batching tweak, release-notes: https://ci.redwood/release/3.2.1
tanvi: seeing embed-service 95p latency jump in eu-west within the first 90s :thinking:
tanvi: error rate 5xx -> 0.8% -> 2.4% since traffic shifted
luis: can you paste the query samples? wondering if it's request-size or tokenizer change
olivia: metrics dashboard: https://dash.redwood/apps/canary/9f8a3b6 eu-west panel attached (brief snapshot)
sam: quick call: pause or continue? what are rollback costs if we pin?
micah: we can pin back to v3.2.0 in region, should be instant route change, no infra churn
lu is: @luis ping — any red flags from trace logs?
luis: traces show KV cache evictions + longer cold-starts on tail sequences. looks like batching heuristic increased mem churn
micah: plan B: pause rollout (0% new), set fallback-route to v3.2.0 for eu-west only, run a hotfix branch if needed
deploy-bot: executing: 
```
# pause percent rollout
redwood deploy --region eu-west --model v3.2.1 --set-percent 0 --reason "pause: latency spike"
# pin fallback
redwood route set --region eu-west --from v3.2.1 --to v3.2.0 --force
```
deploy-bot: done: traffic set to 0% for v3.2.1 in eu-west (timestamp 1766661248)
tanvi: confirming metrics stabilizing after flip, 95p latency back to baseline in ~30s :thumbsup:
olivia: can we capture a replay dataset of the failing requests for offline repro?
luis: grabbing samples to bucket: s3://redwood-canary-samples/1766661234/failures.tar.gz
sam: decision: pause + pin regionally. no global rollback. ops runbook updated: https://wiki.redwood/release/procedures#canary-rollback (notifying customers via internal ops channel)
micah: followups: add a regression test for batching heuristic, schedule a small-bake with KVCACHE stress test before next push
deploy-bot: note: release notes flagged as "partial rollout aborted in eu-west, hold for fix"
tanvi: thanks team, I'll own the hotfix PR and circle back with timeline
sam: thanks all. if metrics re-spike, escalate to SEV-1 channel. :white_check_mark:
